text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’m interested in your full-time role because I enjoy working on high-traffic, real-time products and long-term teams. In a recent project for Kestrel Insurance, I built an end-to-end test suite for the broker quoting flow using Playwright, TypeScript, GitHub Actions, and Docker. It included 160 browser tests that run on every pull request, and it helped reduce release regressions from 6 per quarter to 1.

I’m comfortable working closely with QA and engineering teams, and I’d be glad to contribute to your backend and frontend work.
